correction.statement: For a promised valid RP verifier, hitting one accepting original random tape suffices on YES inputs; exact acceptance counting is unnecessary.

theorem.model: syntax-preserving occurrence splitting with connected exact equality gadgets
theorem.minor: original clause-variable incidence graph is a minor of the localized encoding
theorem.recursive_separator_consequence: separator <=c log m and child size <=sqrt(m) at every node implies treewidth <=2c log N+O(1)
theorem.wall_control: bounded-degree walls have Theta(r^2) vertices and Theta(r) treewidth
theorem.conclusion: equality localization cannot compile all CNFs into recursive logarithmic-interface instances
theorem.excluded_claim: no runtime lower bound and no barrier against nonlocal semantic reductions
